sourceChecks.text: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

sourceChecks.text: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

sourceChecks.text: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
